verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents secure upload and storage of employee documents within individual employee profiles. It also describes an automated hire-and-onboard flow that starts from the offer letter. However, the evidence never says offer letters or HR documents can be sent for e-signature, so the core signing piece is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit e-signature capability for offer letters/HR documents, detail on sending documents to candidates or employees for signing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
